title: HorizonBench: Long-Horizon Personalization with Evolving Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2604.17283v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Personal assistants now talk with the same user for months, and users' preferences change as their lives change; an assistant that keeps serving a preference the user has outgrown fails that user. Real conversations do not record when or why a preference changed, and existing benchmarks either hold preferences fixed or have the user state the change, so they cannot tell whether a model forgot what the user said or failed to update its belief about the user. We introduce HorizonBench and its data generator, which samples how a user's preferences change and generates six months of conversation from that sequence; each change follows a life event that the user mentions without stating the new preference. A human longitudinal preference dataset that we collect and release, 83,024 ratings from 160 people over 13 weeks, sets how often and how much life events change preferences. translated_title: HorizonBench：具有演变偏好的长程个性化基准测试
translated_abstract: 个人助理如今与同一用户对话长达数月，而用户的偏好会随着生活的变化而改变；一个继续按照用户早已不再需要的偏好来服务的助理，就是对该用户的失职。真实对话并不会记录偏好何时或为何发生变化，而现有的基准测试要么将偏好固定不变，要么让用户明确陈述变化，因此无法区分模型究竟是忘记了用户说过的话，还是未能更新对用户的认知。我们提出了HorizonBench及其数据生成器，它能够采样用户偏好的变化方式，并根据该变化序列生成长达六个月的对话；每次偏好变化都源于一个用户提到的生活事件，但用户并不会直接说明新的偏好。我们收集并发布了一个人类纵向偏好数据集，包含160人在13周内提供的83,024条评分，用以确定生活事件改变偏好的频率和幅度。HorizonBench包含来自360位用户的4,245个问题……
tldr: HorizonBench是一个通过隐含提及的生活事件驱动用户偏好演变的长程个性化基准测试，用于评估AI助理能否从对话线索中感知并正确更新对用户偏好的认知。
en_tdlr: HorizonBench is a long-horizon personalization benchmark in which user preferences evolve through implicitly mentioned life events, testing whether AI assistants can detect and update their beliefs about users' changing preferences.
